{"id":1903230010,"question_id":4176,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769873035,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"53 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1903230010/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum K to Reduce Array Within Limit","memory":"197.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long binarysearch(vector<int>&nums , int mid)\n    {\n        ll opr = 0;\n        for(int it : nums) opr += (it + mid - 1) / mid;\n        return opr;\n    }\n    \n    int minimumK(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int s = 1;\n        ll sum = accumulate(nums.begin() , nums.end() , 0LL);\n        ll inbound = (int)sqrt(sum) + 2;\n        int l = *max_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        int e = max(l , (int)inbound);\n        \n        long long ans = e;\n\n        while(s <= e){\n            int mid = s + (e-s)/2;\n            if(binarysearch(nums , mid) <= (1LL * mid * mid))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else s = mid + 1;\n        }\n        \n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-k-to-reduce-array-within-limit","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1613}
